in_sanskrit.name: Garvam
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The feeling of pride or self-esteem arising from the possession of wealth, power, or a high social position.

in_hindi.name: गर्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: The feeling of pride, self-esteem, or ego. It can also mean the feeling of being proud of someone or something.

in_tamil.name: கரவ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The feeling of pride or self-esteem, often associated with one's position, wealth, or power. It can also mean the feeling of being proud of someone or something.

in_telugu.name: గర్వ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The feeling of pride, self-esteem, or ego. It can also mean the feeling of being proud of someone or something.

in_marathi.name: Garv
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pride, Self-respect, Ego
in_marathi.long_meaning: Garv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Garv is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'grh' which means 'to dwell'. This name symbolizes the feeling of self-respect, pride, and ego. It is believed that the person named Garv is self-confident, courageous, and has a strong sense of self-worth.
